triage.summary: Anna Lee asks to move tomorrow’s 11:00 call to Thursday at the same time because something came up.

task.title: Respond to Anna about moving the call
task.description: Anna Lee asks to reschedule the 11:00 call on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, to Thursday, October 15, at 11:00. Decide whether to accept the proposed time and reply.

reply.body:
Hi Anna,

Thanks for letting me know. Thursday at 11:00 [works for me].

Alex
